name: bmcshell-terminal-profile
description: Open the bmcshell (Spring Shell) application in an IDE terminal, from a local jar or the bmcshell Docker image

commands.title: bmcshell Profile: Open Two Terminals (Split, ports 8443 + 8444)

enumDescriptions: Run the bmcshell jar with a local Java 21+ runtime
Run the bmcshell Docker image (same options as bmcshell.sh)

bmcshellProfile.jarPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to a custom bmcshell jar. Leave empty to use the jar bundled with the extension (`bin/bmcshell.jar`). Use the `bmcshell Profile: Select Jar File` command to pick one.

bmcshellProfile.javaPath.description: Java executable (Java 21 or newer is required)

bmcshellProfile.jvmArgs.description: Extra JVM arguments passed before -jar, one argument per entry

bmcshellProfile.port.description: Port for the bmcshell embedded server (passed as -Dserver.port)

bmcshellProfile.secondPort.description: Port for the second bmcshell server (split terminal and second journal pane). Must differ from bmcshellProfile.port

bmcshellProfile.workingDirectory.description: Working directory for bmcshell (history, machines files). Empty uses ~/.bmcshell

bmcshellProfile.dockerImage.description: Docker image used when bmcshellProfile.mode is 'docker'

bmcshellProfile.journal.host.description: Host name of the running bmcshell servers whose /sse/journal streams are shown (ports are bmcshellProfile.port and bmcshellProfile.secondPort)

bmcshellProfile.journal.caCertPath.markdownDescription: PEM file used to verify the bmcshell server certificate (the CA certificate, or the server certificate itself for a self-signed setup). Leave empty to use the system trust store. Certificate verification cannot be disabled.

bmcshellProfile.journal.tlsServerName.description: Host name expected in the server certificate when it differs from bmcshellProfile.journal.host (e.g. the CN of the certificate)

bmcshellProfile.journal.autoReconnect.description: Reconnect with backoff when the stream drops

bmcshellProfile.journal.maxLines.description: Maximum number of journal lines kept in the viewer

scripts.lint: node --check src/extension.js && node --check src/launcher.js && node --check src/journalClient.js && node --check src/journalView.js && node --check src/journalPanel.js && node --check src/credentialManager.js
scripts.test: node test/journalClient.test.js && node test/journalPanel.test.js && node test/credentialManager.test.js
